authority_tiers.name: official-maintainer-reference
authority_tiers.condition: directly applicable to the detected product/version

families.description: Google Search Central sources governing technical eligibility, crawling, indexing, canonicalization, sitemaps, robots, content guidance, spam policies, and search appearance.
families.retrieval_hint: Use for any claim about Google Search behavior, eligibility, crawling/indexing, canonicalization, content policy, or search appearance.

families.description: Current Google documentation for AI Overviews, AI Mode, generative AI search guidance, and AI-related preview/visibility controls.
families.retrieval_hint: Use when auditing AI Search/GEO/AEO claims, AI visibility, generative AI content guidance, or controls affecting Search AI features.

families.description: Google Search structured-data documentation defining supported features, eligibility, required properties, and implementation guidance.
families.retrieval_hint: Use before calling structured data required, useful, eligible, deprecated, or feature-specific.

families.description: Version-sensitive official Next.js documentation and release/security information.
families.retrieval_hint: Open after detecting Next.js or whenever framework APIs, metadata, sitemap, robots, rendering, caching, proxy, or security are involved.

families.description: web.dev performance and Core Web Vitals documentation, including current metric definitions, thresholds, measurement, and optimization guidance.
families.retrieval_hint: Use for LCP, INP, CLS, field vs lab measurement, and performance optimization decisions.

families.description: OWASP application-security standards and cheat sheets for attack-surface-driven security auditing.
families.retrieval_hint: Use for web/API security, input handling, auth/session, access control, SSRF, XSS, CSRF, security headers, supply chain, and exception handling.

families.description: W3C/WAI normative and supporting accessibility guidance, centered on WCAG 2.2 and applicable ARIA standards.
families.retrieval_hint: Use for semantic HTML, accessibility conformance, keyboard/focus, names/roles/states, and ARIA behavior.

families.description: Schema.org current stable vocabulary and release information.
families.retrieval_hint: Use to verify that a proposed type/property exists and to identify the current stable vocabulary version; Google documentation remains authoritative for Google feature eligibility.

families.description: Dynamic discovery layer bound at runtime to an approved web search provider such as Exa. Search results are leads, not evidence.
families.retrieval_hint: Use only for current/ambiguous/emerging claims, exploit/behavior context, conflict resolution, or discovery when structured sources are insufficient. Always open material sources and preserve query/result provenance.
